nodes.label: Separate local AST and maintained documentation corpora
nodes.norm_label: separate local ast and maintained documentation corpora
nodes.rationale: First-party code/tests/config use local ASTs. Maintained Markdown is extracted interactively; evidence/research/archives are excluded and proposed/mixed status is preserved.

nodes.label: Reviewed portable semantic graph and receipt
nodes.norm_label: reviewed portable semantic graph and receipt
nodes.rationale: Configuration/tooling/instructions and optionally reviewed portable semantic graph plus receipt are shared. Linear state, caches, staging and local AST outputs stay ignored.

nodes.label: Nonblocking host guidance and opt-in preserved Git hooks
nodes.norm_label: nonblocking host guidance and opt-in preserved git hooks
nodes.rationale: Avrana wrapper preserves prior hooks and Games privacy gate, adds Linear/freshness boundaries and post-merge support. Claude reminder is nonblocking; Codex follows AGENTS because upstream Codex PreToolUse is a no-op.

nodes.label: Semantic freshness is checked separately
nodes.rationale: Missing or stale documentation semantics require direct canonical reads or interactive host-agent regeneration; inferred edges remain hypotheses.

nodes.label: Linear, canonical docs/ADRs and implementation authority
nodes.norm_label: linear, canonical docs/adrs and implementation authority
nodes.rationale: Graphify supports navigation only. Linear governs live work; canonical docs/ADRs govern intended architecture with actual status/amendments; code/tests govern implementation.

nodes.label: ADR 0011 automatic Party console
nodes.rationale: Merged source resumes profile presence and follows authoritative location; deployment and phone proof remain AVR-212.

nodes.label: Unverified Tier 3 phone behavior
nodes.rationale: Cloud/Chromium checks do not establish real iPhone certificate, DNS or wake-lock behavior.

nodes.label: Static HTTPS Party shell
nodes.rationale: Nginx serves static files; separate Party Core retains authority behind /party/api/.

nodes.label: Temporary donor singleton chat adapter
nodes.rationale: Token travels in hello/header rather than URLs; weak clear/authorization remains debt.

nodes.label: Same-origin legacy profile compatibility
nodes.rationale: Compatibility keys are not authentication or Party roster, and cannot be safely recovered across HTTP/HTTPS origins.

nodes.label: Experimental PS1 catalog metadata
nodes.rationale: User titles and viewport requirements have no installed grant, launch URL or hardware acceptance.

nodes.label: Non-secret avrana.lan-launch/v1 marker
nodes.rationale: Direct integrated launch rejects unsupported providers and arbitrary return URLs while retaining standalone behavior.

nodes.label: Canonical library aliases in shared keys
nodes.norm_label: canonical library aliases in shared keys
nodes.rationale: Reads collapse known slugs while preserving unknown entries; opening counts are not proven play or results.

nodes.label: Deterministic registry export to Avrana catalog
nodes.norm_label: deterministic registry export to avrana catalog
nodes.rationale: Registry exporter creates public descriptor, then Party compiler validates grants; digest and check mode detect drift.

nodes.label: Side-effect constrained capability probes
nodes.rationale: Context facts are separate; prompting APIs never run automatically.

nodes.label: Silent keep-awake policy
nodes.rationale: Play taps request Wake Lock; hidden pages release it and failures merely let screens dim.

nodes.label: Network-first scoped offline copy
nodes.rationale: Worker touches /party/ shell GETs only, never live API or streams; it cannot repair expired TLS.

nodes.label: Avrana owns cross-game product features
nodes.rationale: Donor is legacy infrastructure; Avrana owns identity, navigation, catalog and shared UX.

nodes.label: Sanitized catalog and live slug validation
nodes.norm_label: sanitized catalog and live slug validation
nodes.rationale: Metadata describes known titles; API failure means unavailable and never invents a grant.

nodes.label: Avrana global shell and provider game ownership
nodes.norm_label: avrana global shell and provider game ownership
nodes.rationale: Avrana owns discovery/profile/library; provider owns rules, hands, controls and assets, preserving standalone compatibility.

nodes.label: Separate provider and Party worker ownership
nodes.norm_label: separate provider and party worker ownership
nodes.rationale: Integrated pages must not register donor root worker; donor deletes only its caches and bypasses /party/.

nodes.label: BLUFF audit: proposed fixes
nodes.rationale: Dated read-only audit identifies unannounced prompts, focus loss and inaccessible div controls; fixes were not applied.

nodes.label: Display-only accessibility manifest
nodes.rationale: Values admit unknown and do not yet filter or block games; video cannot reflow emulated games.

nodes.label: Proposed per-player preferences
nodes.rationale: Independent private screens permit personal accommodations without altering other players.

nodes.label: Proposed lag-aware buzzer fairness
nodes.rationale: Server-time arming and plausible reaction windows reduce Wi-Fi bias, while acknowledging cheating limits.

nodes.label: Proposed sealed response window
nodes.rationale: Frozen eligibility, prompt IDs, deadlines and per-viewer views standardize framing; scoring stays game-owned.

nodes.label: Four homes for shared code
nodes.rationale: Party service, game-run SDK, optional client UI kit and game logic have distinct ownership.

nodes.label: CSS normalized geometry and contain fit
nodes.norm_label: css normalized geometry and contain fit
nodes.rationale: CSS avoids added per-frame JS, normalized content rectangles preserve aspect and contain avoids cutting HUD.

nodes.label: Partial laptop and Pi proof stages
nodes.norm_label: partial laptop and pi proof stages
nodes.rationale: Synthetic geometry and simulated phones do not establish real title/input acceptance; StageB frame-rate criterion was unmet.

nodes.label: One shared encode with client seat crop
nodes.norm_label: one shared encode with client seat crop
nodes.rationale: Browsers crop the same frame without per-player encoding.

nodes.label: Player page accessibility requirements
nodes.rationale: Named semantic controls, 44px targets, scalable text, non-color cues, focus preservation and contrast support access.

nodes.label: Automated and manual accessibility testing
nodes.rationale: Smoke tests measure controls/layout, while real phone screen reader and large-text checks cover release behavior.

nodes.label: Server-side private views and leak testing
nodes.norm_label: server-side private views and leak testing
nodes.rationale: CSS hiding and broadcast secrets are unsafe; anonymity must specify who can observe it.

nodes.label: Phone as private dynamic player surface
nodes.norm_label: phone as private dynamic player surface
nodes.rationale: Private prompts, hands and personalized access offer capabilities a shared gamepad cannot; TV remains optional.

nodes.label: Viewport crop is not private and saves no Wi-Fi
nodes.norm_label: viewport crop is not private and saves no wi-fi
nodes.rationale: Every phone receives every quadrant at full bitrate; secrets need native per-viewer data.

nodes.label: Default full view with manual viewport control
nodes.norm_label: default full view with manual viewport control
nodes.rationale: Permanent crops break menus; host chosen layouts and hold-to-peek are safer than unproved auto-detection.

nodes.label: AGENTS operational and Graphify freshness rules
nodes.norm_label: agents operational and graphify freshness rules

nodes.label: No independent source of truth or task queue
nodes.norm_label: no independent source of truth or task queue

nodes.label: Party Host and System Admin are separate
nodes.norm_label: party host and system admin are separate

nodes.label: Device, Profile, Presence, Seat, Role and Persona are distinct
nodes.norm_label: device, profile, presence, seat, role and persona are distinct

nodes.label: Accepted amendment: one appliance, one party, optional TV
nodes.norm_label: accepted amendment: one appliance, one party, optional tv

nodes.label: Server-resolved secrets authorize only their scope
nodes.norm_label: server-resolved secrets authorize only their scope

nodes.label: Display names and controller slots never authorize
nodes.norm_label: display names and controller slots never authorize

nodes.label: Identifier encoding, persistence and storage remain open
nodes.norm_label: identifier encoding, persistence and storage remain open

nodes.label: Avrana global services; LAN Games individual game implementation
nodes.norm_label: avrana global services; lan games individual game implementation

nodes.label: Graphify: derived navigation and independent semantic freshness
nodes.norm_label: graphify: derived navigation and independent semantic freshness
nodes.rationale: Inferred edges are hypotheses; verify canonical sources and reject stale/missing semantic context.

nodes.label: Games owns gameplay; Party owns identity/presence/chat/navigation
nodes.norm_label: games owns gameplay; party owns identity/presence/chat/navigation
nodes.rationale: No parallel platform stores or tokens.

nodes.label: Read-only private Linear snapshots with six-hour TTL
nodes.norm_label: read-only private linear snapshots with six-hour ttl
nodes.rationale: Never commit private exports, machine paths, runtime data or manually mark stale receipts current.

nodes.label: Optional game integration mechanisms: originally proposed
nodes.norm_label: optional game integration mechanisms: originally proposed
nodes.rationale: Small contracts retain game-owned rules/rendering/netcode and grow only with multiple consumers; later ADRs implement mechanisms.

nodes.label: Accepted direction: one persistent party platform
nodes.norm_label: accepted direction: one persistent party platform
nodes.rationale: Per-game identity multiplies duplicate systems; the game may change while the party remains.

nodes.label: Statistics carry authoritative versus observed provenance
nodes.norm_label: statistics carry authoritative versus observed provenance
nodes.rationale: Participation in emulated games is not a win without an explicit adapter.

nodes.label: Per-session participant game key and persona
nodes.norm_label: per-session participant game key and persona
nodes.rationale: Games never receive device/profile credentials and cannot accept arbitrary legacy tokens during Party sessions.

nodes.label: Accepted key separation invariants; formats/storage proposed
nodes.norm_label: accepted key separation invariants; formats/storage proposed
nodes.rationale: Mixing identity and credentials would taint every record and authorization boundary.

nodes.label: Deterministic avrana.lan-catalog/v1 donor descriptor
nodes.rationale: Reviewed revision/digest and cross-repo drift tests preserve the authoritative registry; routes remain appliance grants.

nodes.label: Credential-free avrana.lan-launch/v1 integrated URLs
nodes.rationale: Unsupported donors fail visibly and donor capability must precede platform activation.

nodes.label: Integrated pages bypass donor root service worker
nodes.norm_label: integrated pages bypass donor root service worker
nodes.rationale: Preserve foreign caches and Party HTTPS/offline scope.

nodes.label: Compatibility identity and one library/chat store
nodes.norm_label: compatibility identity and one library/chat store
nodes.rationale: No competing global chat or parallel library; opened history is not execution success.
